high: src/v2/lunch/LunchWorldApp.tsx:54 — Unapproved TEMP world is the actual entry screen — LunchWorldMap is mounted without assets, so its explicitly TEMP_IMPLEMENTATION_ONLY CSS/SVG design and visible TEMP labels are shipped in the vertical slice, contrary to DESIGN_OWNERSHIP §2 requiring temporary visuals to stay non-public — supply approved world assets or keep this route behind a development-only gate.

src/v2/lunch/screens/JobReveal.tsx:8 — CLEAR proceeds directly into visible temporary screens — JobReveal and SeedPick render TEMP_IMPLEMENTATION_ONLY/DESIGN_NEEDED content as mandatory user-flow screens, so the vertical slice is not design-locked or releaseable — replace DN-08/DN-09 layouts and copy with approved designs, or terminate the reviewed slice before these screens until approval exists.
medium: src/v2/lunch/play/LunchMenuPlay.tsx:210 — Flight state can be invalidated while its animation still lands — placement mutates the tray before the 380 ms flight completes, leaving the transparent arriving slot enabled; tapping it removes the dish, but the old timer still produces pop and sparks on the empty slot. An already-armed EVENT can similarly remove the flying dish before the timer lands — lock removal for the arriving slot or cancel flight effects whenever that slot/dish leaves the tray.

src/v2/lunch/play/LunchMenuPlay.tsx:218 — Rapid placements share global animation state — each new tap replaces fly and resets flyGo, but prior 20/380 ms timers remain active; an earlier timer can start the newer clone prematurely and generate a phantom landing on its old slot — track and cancel timers per flight sequence, and guard every landing side effect, not only setFly/setArriving, by the sequence token.

factory/harness/gameplay-qa-v2-lunch-menu.mjs:23 — Advertised tmpdir isolation is incomplete — npm run qa:v2-lunch fails before any of its 26 checks because Vite still writes bundled config files under node_modules/.vite-temp; cacheDir only relocates the dependency cache — load Vite with a non-writing config strategy (for example configFile:false plus the required inline plugins) or otherwise redirect config bundling too.

factory/harness/gameplay-qa-v2-lunch-menu.mjs:55 — Rendered-cue proof is synthetic rather than contract-level — the test fabricates an impossible evaluation with duplicate tray IDs and one invented hit per rule, so it only proves StatusLayer echoes supplied rule names; it does not prove evaluate can produce each rule from valid trays or that its real dish/detail data yields a correctly positioned cue — find a valid enumerated witness for every RuleId and render/assert each real evaluation.

factory/harness/gameplay-qa-v2-lunch-menu.mjs:101 — UI race conditions are wholly outside the QA suite — exhaustive EVENT recovery covers pure functions only, while the new timers, refs, rapid taps, StrictMode behavior, removal in flight, and EVENT-during-flight paths have no automated assertions — add fake-timer/component tests covering these adversarial sequences and assert both session and transient-effect cleanup.

src/v2/lunch/play/LunchMenuPlay.tsx:262 — Hidden delivery control remains exposed to assistive technology — the school button is always present with an accessible name and merely disabled/opacity-zero before commit, so screen-reader users encounter a destination that sighted users cannot see — conditionally render it when relevant or apply an equivalent hidden state until commitReady.
low: src/v2/lunch/play/LunchMenuPlay.tsx:467 — Basket fallback lacks the required on-screen TEMP marker — all three basket PNGs are absent from public/assets/v2/lunch, so production execution uses placeholder basket shapes; unlike other placeholders, those shapes contain no visible TEMP_IMPLEMENTATION_ONLY marker — add approved basket assets or visibly mark each fallback and prevent it from release.

factory/harness/v2-lunch-shots.mjs:51 — Screenshot timing does not match its own label — four sequential taps each wait 220 ms, then the script waits another 700 ms, so 03-first-complete-grains is normally captured after the 1.4-second grain cleanup rather than during flight — capture relative to the final tap without the accumulated waits or assert that .lmp-grain exists before shooting.
